zh-CN.name: OpenClaw
zh-CN.summary: 开源个人 AI 助手，支持多渠道网关和本地优先架构
zh-CN.description: OpenClaw 是一个开源的个人 AI 助手平台，提供多渠道网关（WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack、Discord 等）、本地优先架构、会话管理和工具策略控制等能力。支持流式输出、对话压缩和 hooks 扩展。

en-US.name: OpenClaw
en-US.summary: Open-source personal AI assistant with a multi-channel gateway and local-first architecture
en-US.description: OpenClaw is an open-source personal AI assistant platform with a multi-channel gateway (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and more), a local-first architecture, session management, and tool policy controls. It supports streaming output, conversation compaction, and hook-based extensions.
